name: Board hygiene: audit IT team cards for artefacts that do not exist in this project (intake rule)
description:
PURPOSE
Three of the ten cards on the `IT team` board name files that are NOT reachable from this repository (`wiki` = codx-junior-platform/wiki). Each one cost a wasted AI run before it was found. This card records the rule and cleans the board so the pattern stops.

EVIDENCE COLLECTED BY ProjectManager (shift #3, 2026-11-18)
- `2ec7f26c` (board tool defect: `update_task` ignores `profiles`) — no board-tool source in this project: `project_map` lists 156 files with `server.py` as the only source file; `project_locate("update_task")` returns docs only.
- `09f89542` (token at `codx-junior-installer/demo/ENVIRONMENT.md:77`) — `read_folder(".")` shows no `codx-junior-installer/` anywhere at the root; `project_locate(..., project="all")` reports `across 1 project(s)`, so no sibling repo is registered.
- `d75e77a1` (column naming) — board columns are `Inbox / Working / Scheduled / Done`; the standing order text says `To Do / Doing`. Internal inconsistency, not an external artefact.

WHAT TO DO
1. Call `list_boards` and `list_tasks(board="IT team", include_archived=false)`.
2. For every open card, extract the file paths / repo names quoted in its name or description and check them with `project_locate` (or `read_folder` if the atlas is rebuilding).
3. Classify each card as: (a) reachable — leave alone; (b) external repo — keep, but its description must START with the line `ROUTING: external to this project — <repo name>; no agent on this board can open these files`; (c) path typo — correct it.
4. Append to each affected card a `request_help` note with the classification and the evidence command you used. Do NOT change status, wake_at, progress or assignee of any card — ProjectManager owns scheduling.
5. Record the intake rule in the board description of `IT team` via `update_board` (append only, do not rewrite what is there):
   "Intake rule: a card must name at least one path that exists in THIS project. If the work belongs to another repository, the card must say so in its first line and name the repository."

HARD NO
- No `filter-repo`, no `rebase --root`, no force-push, no history rewrite of any kind.
- Do not commit anything. Card `c476e095` owns the only pending commit (5 staged files).
- Do not mark any card done or move cards between columns.
- Do not create new sprints or boards.

ACCEPTANCE
- Every open `IT team` card is classified (a)/(b)/(c) and the classification for each is written on the card itself.
- `IT team` board description contains the intake rule line.
- Report back the list: card id → classification → evidence command.

WHY `TaskManager`
This is pure board hygiene: reading cards, adding notes and appending to a board description. TaskManager owns the kanban board; no code is involved, so a developer profile would be the wrong tier.

## Pre-workfinding for this audit (evidence collected ahead of the 2026-11-20 wake)

Three artefact-existence results produced by the standard `project_read_file` probe, usable as-is when this card opens:

| Card | Artefact named | Probe result | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `09f89542` | `codx-junior-installer/demo/ENVIRONMENT.md:77` | **File not found** | **Out of project.** The root is `codx-junior-platform/wiki`; the installer repo is a different project. The card is unactionable from here unless it is moved to the installer project. |
| `8a432c15` (my own addendum) | `Dockerfile` ("missing") | **17 lines returned** | **My claim was wrong** — retracted on both cards. |
| `4173cfd4` | `qa_policy` | `project_locate(..., regex=true)` → 0 matches; `.codx/project.json` has no `qa_policy` key | Correctly classified as a platform setting, not a file. |

### Proposed intake rule (for this card's deliverable)
Any new `IT team` card that names a repository path must carry the **verbatim output of `project_read_file`** (content or `File not found`) in its description. Two of three sampled cards above failed that test, one of them filed by me.

No card was moved and nothing was closed by this comment; this card keeps its `Scheduled` / `todo` state and its 2026-11-20T09:00Z wake.
